Now you will hear a presentation about the Renaissance. The presentation is about Johannes Gutenberg, an inventor who built the first printing press in Europe around 1450. If Gutenberg had to ask people for money to build his press, this is what his pitch might have sounded like. Listen carefully. You will hear the presentation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions. As you listen, you may take notes.
